Largest text: the two-line black bold centered title (with the single yellow highlight and red subscripts grabbing the eye first). Next tier: the large colored blocks — tan Dot Product box, pink Soft max bar, light-blue Σ box — and the three yellow label pills. Finest tier: the small 3-block embedding vectors, blue W₂ᵢ labels, ⊗ nodes and blue dots. The chunky green and red block arrows are small but high-salience accents.

visual_elements.description: Self-attention dataflow for query word X₂, left-to-right. NODES: (1) Input stack — green dashed rounded container (light-green fill) holding four horizontal 3-block vectors labeled X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄ top-to-bottom (each vector = yellow block + pink block carrying a red subscripted label + lavender block). (2) 'Dot Product' box — large tan rectangle; inside are four solid dark-blue dots with thin dark outlines, one on each incoming horizontal line, staggered so the top dot is farthest right and the bottom dot farthest left; red arrows slant up-and-right from each dot, converging toward the box's right edge. (3) 'Soft max' bar — tall narrow plum rounded rectangle, purple rotated label. (4) 'Σ' box — wide short light-blue rectangle with large blue Σ. (5) Output box — small green dashed rounded container holding a 3-block green vector labeled 'Y' (middle block). (6) Four multiplication nodes — white circles with red rings and red asterisks (⊗-style), one on each weighted-sum line, staggered stepping down-to-the-right. (7) Right stack — green dashed container with four 3-block vectors labeled X₁–X₄ (tiny type; mirrors input stack). (8) Sentence strip — green dashed container at bottom with four vectors X₁–X₄ left-to-right; the second (X₂) emphasized with pink fill and magenta dashed border. ARROWS (thin red unless noted): each input-stack row feeds horizontally right into the Dot Product box ending at a blue dot; from the dots the converging red arrows exit the box's right side and continue as horizontal arrows into the left side of the Soft max bar (four entry lines in the bar's upper half); a long thin red arrow rises vertically from highlighted X₂ in the sentence strip into the bottom edge of the Dot Product box (the query); Soft max emits four horizontal red arrows rightward labeled W₂₁, W₂₂, W₂₃, W₂₄ top-to-bottom, each passing through its ⊗ node; from each ⊗ node a vertical red line runs up into the Σ box (arrowhead at Σ) and the horizontal line continues right into the matching row of the right stack; a thick green block arrow points up from the Σ box to the Y output box; two long dashed light-green curves connect the sentence strip to the bottoms of the left and right stacks (arrowheads pointing up into the stacks); a chunky red block arrow at the strip's lower-left points up-right at the highlighted X₂ block.
